proposed_from.topic: K1 define a trace-aware colored fixing calculus for finite positive regular-maximal labeled-missingness graphs, allowing fixing before context restriction. K2 prove every returned observed-law functional sound. K3 prove completeness by returning a colored hedge and two positive same-observed/different-query lm-SCMs. K4 give a terminating finite procedure without claiming polynomial time. Include the Figure 3(b) fix-then-select witness and ADHD medication/test-achievement FATE/NATE consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The witness first derives P(Y given do(A),R_W), then selects R_W=0 to obtain P(Y given A,R_W=0), showing why restrict-then-fix can lose information. Colored kernels can record which label licenses each operation, and finite positivity permits algebraic equality tests and response-function witnesses. An ID-style induction over colored reachable districts appears viable; epsilon perturbations may make hedge models strictly positive while preserving observed traces. Small-graph consistency and general positivity remain unchecked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove legal colored fixings commute when required, and prove every recursion failure yields a finite colored hedge realizable by two strictly positive regular-maximal lm-SCMs with identical observed proxy laws and different query values. EARLY KILL TEST: Enumerate the smallest graphs containing Figure 3(b), compare the calculus with exact response-function elimination, and construct each claimed positive hedge pair. Stop if two legal fixing orders conflict, the procedure misses an identified functional, or a returned hedge cannot realize same-observed models.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: {"closest_results":"The closest direct result is de Aguas et al. (2025), whose NATE criterion is explicitly sufficient and whose Figure 3(b) demonstrates the missing operation order. The closest complete calculus is ordinary ID of Shpitser and Pearl (2006), which has neither proxy traces nor label-dependent mechanism deletion.","strict_delta":"The symbolic if-and-only-if theorem partitions every compatible positive regular-maximal observed-law fiber into exact recovery and nonrecovery cells. It preserves the de Aguas Proposition 4 and Mokhtarian root-control functionals, succeeds beyond both on the explicitly worked \\(\\mathcal G_\\star\\) and the full \\(\\mathfrak G_{\\mathrm{EIPFD}}\\) family, and independently compiles every negative exact specialization through a first-divergent recursion state to a colored hedge plus two strictly positive same-observed, different-query lm-SCMs.","non_subsumption":"CSI-calculus lacks general completeness, root-control completeness excludes endogenous indicators and substantive proxies, missing-data recursion lacks label traces, and general response-function polynomialization does not prove equality with the individual-edge-factorized lm-SCM fiber."}

seed_details.seed: Trace-aware colored fixing with positive colored-hedge completeness
seed_details.anchor: pmlr-v286-aguas25a, Introduction, Figure 3(b), Proposition 4, and Conclusion
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace context-first decomposition by a colored reachable-kernel invariant that permits fixing before restriction and retains the observed-law denominator trace.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for trace-aware fixing, colored fixing, colored hedges, and lm-graph completeness found no occupied target beyond the 2025 lm-graph paper.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from combining CSI-calculus with missing-data fixing and ordinary ID completeness.
seed_details.rebuttal: The anchor explicitly says that combination need not be complete; none of the components transports label licenses, proxy traces, and positive hedge realization together.

seed_details.anchor: ShpitserPearl2006JointID, Definition 7 and Theorem 4; pmlr-v286-aguas25a, Conclusion
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the ordinary parity model by a latent-district response-function compiler that equates every colored observed proxy trace before enforcing strict positivity.
seed_details.destination_search: The colored-hedge and label-preserving positive-witness pair was not found; Duarte et al. supply only a general polynomial oracle.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from adding common noise to the two ordinary hedge models.
seed_details.rebuttal: Common mixing or naive noise can destroy label-specific independencies and district factorization; exact equality must hold simultaneously for all proxy traces.

seed_details.anchor: RichardsonEvansRobinsShpitser2023, Lemma 30 and Theorem 31; pmlr-v286-aguas25a, Figure 3(b)
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Strengthen the ordinary adjacent-swap argument so that it also transports label licenses, positivity domains, and pre-restriction trace provenance.
seed_details.destination_search: No necessary-and-sufficient commutation theorem for fixing and lm-context restriction was located.
seed_details.red_team: A direct corollary of nested fixing-sequence invariance.
seed_details.rebuttal: Ordinary invariance compares divisions within one kernel domain; Figure 3(b) shows that context restriction changes the available domain and can erase an identifying trace.

seed_details.anchor: pmlr-v286-aguas25a, Figure 3(b); DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2023, Proposition 2 and Theorem 1
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Encode shifted mechanisms and all observed proxy traces before comparing the fix-first and restrict-first closures.
seed_details.destination_search: No exhaustive small-lm-graph classification or uniqueness theorem for Figure 3(b) was located.
seed_details.red_team: A finite enumeration exercise with no theorem beyond the displayed example.
seed_details.rebuttal: It becomes a theorem only if the exact enumeration yields a necessary-and-sufficient graphical obstruction up to labeled-graph equivalence.

seed_details.seed: Finite semantic response-function decision oracle for lm-recovery
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Add proxy-coarsening equalities and mandatory label-deletion constraints to the canonical response-function polynomialization.
seed_details.destination_search: Autobounds covers selection and nonresponse but no published encoding of lm-specific mechanism-shift labels was found.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the universality of the existing polynomial program.
seed_details.rebuttal: The semantic reduction is plausible but the new contribution would need an analytic equivalence between lm-SCM compatibility and the added colored constraints, not merely software input.

seed_details.seed: Query recovery strictly beyond full-law recovery in regular-maximal lm-graphs
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Characterize query constancy on the observed fiber without first recovering every full-data propensity factor.
seed_details.destination_search: Full-law criteria and query-specific sufficient lm criteria exist, but no generic strict-separation region for lm-graphs was found.
seed_details.red_team: Existence follows from any standard missing-data graph with an identifiable marginal but unidentified full law.
seed_details.rebuttal: That objection holds for mere existence; a credible version requires a generic graphical iff frontier, so the seed was not kept.

seed_details.seed: Influence-function compiler for returned colored trace functionals
seed_details.anchor: pmlr-v286-aguas25a, Estimation section and Appendix A
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Differentiate the recursive colored functional so that every reused trace kernel contributes one compatible weighted score.
seed_details.destination_search: The anchor derives scores only for one ADHD graph; no general colored-functional influence-function compiler was found.
seed_details.red_team: Automatic differentiation of an identified functional is routine semiparametric calculus.
seed_details.rebuttal: Compatibility across reused trace kernels is nontrivial, but identification must be completed first and this seed does not fit the exact-identification specialization.

seed_details.seed: Binary alphabet lifting for every colored hedge
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace ordinary binary parity by a color-compatible response code that survives mandatory edge deletion in each missingness context.
seed_details.destination_search: No binary sufficiency theorem for labeled-missingness nonidentification certificates was found.
seed_details.red_team: Binary witnesses are already standard for ordinary hedges.
seed_details.rebuttal: The ordinary construction need not respect the same response-table deletion in every labeled context, but the isolated alphabet question is narrower than the complete calculus.
